items.title: 68429_Walter P. Thomas oral history interview
items.q: William L. Dawson was our first band teacher .

ctx.x: Right. Now, guess who my first band teacher was! Man, how I got involved in music... My father wanted me to be an architect. So I went to school, and they had carpentry there, and I figured mechanical drawing, and carpentry was the nearest thing to me getting into architecture, because an architect needs know how to build, what to use as stones and all that. So I studied carpentry with Mr. Burke.
I'm trying to think now how I got involved... Oh. William L. Dawson was our first band teacher .
